story_text.value: I built a whiteboard animator that runs locally without any api keys. It detects regions, guessed how to reveal them and in what order, then sketches it like how a hand would. Let me know what you think. Here's the link: https://github.com/masihsultani/whiteboard-animator

title.value: Show HN: Open-source whiteboard animator running locally
